name: Muhammad Hudaifah Mubarak
headline: B.Tech IT Student at VIT Vellore | Smart Contract Auditor & gRPC Developer
bio_short: B.Tech IT student at VIT Vellore with a lifelong fascination for technology, gaming, zero-knowledge privacy, and distributed systems engineering.
about:
I am a B.Tech Information Technology student at Vellore Institute of Technology (VIT Vellore) with a lifelong fascination for technology, gaming, and systems engineering.

My technical journey bridges low-level distributed protocols, zero-knowledge cryptography, and full-stack software. At DECODE SIH 2026, I served as Smart Contract Auditor & gRPC Developer on Sentinel-ZK—auditing permissioned ZK-ledgers for access control and proof validity, and building high-throughput gRPC communication between bank edge nodes and zk-SNARK verification.

Beyond systems programming, I am an active contributor to the VIT Music Club, passionate about creative audio engineering, competitive gaming, and multi-agent autonomous software architectures.

featured_projects.title: FreightFlow AI: Document-to-Invoice Pre-Fill Engine
featured_projects.tagline: Automated multi-format SI extraction, discrepancy cross-checking, and commercial invoice generation.
featured_projects.description: Engineered an automated document-to-invoice pre-fill engine addressing documented operational bottlenecks at DahNAY Logistics and Chennai/Tuticorin freight forwarders. Reads raw multi-format shipping instructions, extracts container & weight entities, cross-checks against ERP job records to prevent costly Bill of Lading amendment fees ($50-$150/BL), and auto-generates pre-filled commercial invoices with automated currency conversion.
featured_projects.metrics: Live Interactive Demo: /freightflow • Reconciles VGM • ₹1.56 Cr Loss Prevented

featured_projects.title: Sentinel-ZK: Real-Time UPI Fraud Interception
featured_projects.tagline: Privacy-preserving fraud interception without exposing customer PII via Zero-Knowledge proofs.
featured_projects.description: Built during DECODE SIH 2026 (Smart India Hackathon). Acted as Smart Contract Auditor & gRPC Developer. Audited permissioned ZK-ledgers for access control, proof validity, and tamper resistance. Developed low-latency gRPC communication protocols between bank edge nodes and zk-SNARK verification engines, enabling inter-bank fraud intelligence sharing with zero PII exposure.
featured_projects.metrics: DECODE SIH 2026 • zk-SNARKs • gRPC Edge Communication • Zero PII Leakage

featured_projects.metrics: Live Sound Staging • Digital Audio Routing • Multitrack Studio Production
